scenario.topic: Pick the music genre for a campus radio special

options.name: Indie Rock Showcase
options.upside: Offers a mix of emerging and established artists with relatable lyrics.
options.concern: May not appeal to listeners who prefer mainstream or upbeat music.

options.name: Hip-Hop and Rap Hour
options.upside: Engages listeners with energetic beats and culturally relevant themes.
options.concern: Some songs may contain explicit language that requires editing.

options.name: Jazz and Blues Session
options.upside: Provides a relaxing and sophisticated listening experience.
options.concern: Longer song lengths may limit the number of tracks played.

options.name: Electronic Dance Music (EDM) Mix
options.upside: Creates an upbeat and lively atmosphere suitable for campus events.
options.concern: Minimal lyrics may not engage listeners who prefer vocal-driven music.

shared_context: A campus radio special will feature one music genre chosen by five participants. The genre should appeal to a diverse student audience and fit within a two-hour broadcast slot.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a junior studying communications who enjoys discovering new music trends.
personas.private_goal: To feature a genre that balances relatable lyrics with fresh artists to engage diverse listeners.

A.reason_for: Indie Rock offers a mix of emerging and established artists with relatable lyrics, fitting my taste and student interests.

B.reason_for: Hip-Hop is popular and energetic, which could keep the broadcast lively.
B.reason_against: Explicit language might require editing, complicating the broadcast.

C.reason_for: Jazz and Blues provide a relaxing vibe, but may not engage a broad student audience.
C.reason_against: Longer songs limit track variety and lower energy may reduce listener engagement.

D.reason_for: Electronic Dance Music creates an upbeat atmosphere suitable for campus events.
D.reason_against: Minimal lyrics might not satisfy listeners who prefer vocal-driven music.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a senior engineering student who prefers straightforward and efficient communication.
personas.private_goal: To pick a genre that fits well within the two-hour slot and appeals to a niche audience.

A.reason_against: Its moderate popularity and longer songs may not maximize content variety.

D.reason_for: Electronic Dance Music is lively and moderately popular.

personas.background: Eli is a music history major passionate about classic and sophisticated genres.
personas.private_goal: To highlight a genre that offers depth and a relaxing listening experience.
